meta.title: About Us
meta.description: Malibaan is an accounting, tax, and social-insurance advisory standing alongside Iranian businesses — with transparency, professional independence, and a named expert who actually answers.
meta.ogDescription: An accounting, tax, and social-insurance advisory for Iranian businesses.

pageHeader.title: An advisor who sits at your table, not behind a counter
pageHeader.description: Malibaan was built on a simple belief: every Iranian business, regardless of size, deserves financial advice that's precise, transparent, and independent.

story.title: From a small accounting practice to the financial partner of hundreds of businesses
paragraphs: Malibaan started out advising a handful of small businesses — businesses worn down by scattered bookkeepers, inconsistent reports, and tax and insurance penalties that seemed to come out of nowhere. Their problem was always the same: no single, accountable team taking ownership of the whole financial cycle.

Today that practice has grown into a team of accountants, tax advisors, and social-insurance specialists who build one clear financial path for clients — from the day a company is registered through its annual audit. Malibaan has always grown through referrals from satisfied clients, never expensive advertising, and that's kept our priority clear: the quality of the work, not the number of files.
story.imageQuote: Clarity, expertise, and a new standard for accounting.

values.title: Four principles we never trade away under deadline pressure

items.title: Clarity over complexity
items.description: Every financial report is explained in plain language — not just handed over as a spreadsheet only an accountant can read.

items.title: Professional independence
items.description: Our advice serves your business's long-term interest, even when that means recommending fewer services, not more.

items.title: A name behind every answer, not a queue
items.description: Every business is assigned one named expert who has known your file since day one.

items.title: Precision that holds up under scrutiny
items.description: We prepare documents and reports so they stand up without worry to a tax audit, an insurance review, or an independent auditor.

team.title: Experts who actually know your file
team.description: Our team is made up of accountants and tax advisors with years of hands-on experience across industries, and for more complex cases we work alongside certified court experts and independent auditors.

roles.title: Accounting & bookkeeping specialists
roles.description: Own document entry, chart-of-accounts coding, and periodic financial reporting.

roles.title: Tax & insurance advisors
roles.description: Handle tax return filing, social-insurance lists, and representation before review boards.

roles.title: Company & trademark registration specialists
roles.description: Manage the legal process of incorporation, amendments, and IP registration.

roles.title: Independent audit partners
roles.description: Work alongside your team on audit and internal-control engagements.
